files.description: 5-page PDF titled '170.315(b)(10) Electronic Health Information export'. Contains overview of EHI export capability, step-by-step UI instructions for single-patient and bulk export with screenshots, brief description of C-CDA XML output format, HTTP error codes, and product identification. No data dictionary, no schema documentation, no sample data. Export format is C-CDA XML (single patient) or ZIP of C-CDA XML files (bulk). Also offers PDF download for single patients.
